edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Your Q reaches 815 to his Chain Lash 775 and he has no dash yet — place the ball on his last-hit spot and chip him for free.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Shockwave is online but so is Hijack on 80s — never open with R, make him spend it or step up while it is down.

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: Two items in you pull ahead: ball on your diver, Shockwave their clump, and Dissonance the choke they retreat through.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Command: Protect like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 and 9s maxed — his only gap-closer, so step up the second it is spent. - Kingslayer is 12s at rank 1 and heals off you. - Hijack is 80s at level 6 — never open with Shockwave until it is gone.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Ball on your jungler adds shield, armour and MR to the dive.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Drop W under him as he lands Abscond — the Dissonance slow means his 400-range Abduct recast and his walk back out both come up short.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: A third cast leaves the ball 815 units away with nothing to recall it to, and Abscond into Abduct closes that gap before it returns.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Zed hits 6. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — buy the stopwatch the moment Sylas hits 6. Oblivion Orb early cuts Kingslayer's heal.
